title: Zamonlar tizimi: Present Perfect va Past Simple
goal_uz: Present Perfect va Past Simple farqini aniq tushunib, IELTS Speaking'da xatosiz ishlatish.

scenes.title: Bugungi dars: eng ko'p xato qilinadigan ikki zamon
scenes.say: Welcome back. Today we are fixing the single most common grammar mistake I hear in the IELTS Speaking test: mixing up the Present Perfect and the Past Simple. By the end of this lesson, you will never confuse them again.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Bugun IELTS Speaking'da eng ko'p eshitadigan grammatik xatoni tuzatamiz: Present Perfect va Past Simple ni aralashtirish. Dars oxirida ularni boshqa hech qachon adashtirmaysiz.

scenes.title: Asosiy qoida: vaqt aniqmi yoki yo'qmi?
board: Aniq o'tgan vaqt (yesterday, in 2019) → Past Simple
Vaqt aytilmagan, natija hozir muhim → Present Perfect

examples.uz: Men Londonga ikki marta borganman (tajriba, vaqt muhim emas).

scenes.say: Here is the key rule. If you say exactly when something happened, like yesterday or in twenty nineteen, use the Past Simple. If the time is not important and you are talking about your experience or a result now, use the Present Perfect.
scenes.say_uz: Asosiy qoida shu. Agar voqea qachon bo'lganini aniq aytsangiz, masalan kecha yoki 2019-yilda, Past Simple ishlating. Agar vaqt muhim bo'lmasa va tajriba yoki hozirgi natija haqida gapirsangiz, Present Perfect ishlating.

scenes.title: O'zbek talabalarining eng katta xatosi

examples.uz: Noto'g'ri: aniq yil bilan Present Perfect ishlatilmaydi.
To'g'ri: 2020-yil — aniq vaqt, demak Past Simple.

scenes.say: Now listen carefully, because this is the mistake I hear every single day. Never put a finished time word, like yesterday or last year, with the Present Perfect. I have seen him yesterday is wrong. Say: I saw him yesterday.
scenes.say_uz: Endi diqqat bilan tinglang, chunki bu xatoni har kuni eshitaman. Kecha yoki o'tgan yil kabi tugagan vaqt so'zini hech qachon Present Perfect bilan ishlatmang. 'I have seen him yesterday' noto'g'ri. 'I saw him yesterday' deng.

scenes.title: For va since — hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat

examples.t: I have lived in Tashkent for ten years.
examples.uz: Toshkentda o'n yildan beri yashayman (hozir ham).

scenes.say: The Present Perfect also describes a situation that started in the past and is still true now. Use for with a period of time, and since with the starting point. I have lived in Tashkent for ten years means I still live there today.
scenes.say_uz: Present Perfect o'tmishda boshlanib, hozir ham davom etayotgan holatni ham bildiradi. Muddat bilan 'for', boshlanish nuqtasi bilan 'since' ishlating. 'I have lived in Tashkent for ten years' — demak hozir ham o'sha yerda yashayman.

scenes.title: IELTS Speaking'da ikkalasi birga
board: Present Perfect bilan boshlang → Past Simple bilan tafsilot bering

examples.t: I've been to Samarkand several times. The last time I went there, I stayed for a week.
examples.uz: Samarqandga bir necha marta borganman. Oxirgi safar borganimda bir hafta qoldim.

examples.t: I've recently taken up chess. I started last spring because my brother taught me.
examples.uz: Yaqinda shaxmat o'ynashni boshladim. O'tgan bahorda boshlaganman, chunki akam o'rgatdi.

scenes.say: This is what band eight speakers do. They open with the Present Perfect to state the experience, then switch to the Past Simple to tell the story. I have been to Samarkand several times. The last time I went there, I stayed for a week. Beautiful.
scenes.say_uz: Band 8 darajasidagi o'quvchilar aynan shunday qiladi. Tajribani Present Perfect bilan aytib, keyin voqeani Past Simple bilan hikoya qiladi. 'Samarqandga bir necha marta borganman. Oxirgi safar bir hafta qoldim.' Ajoyib.

scenes.title: Mashq: ovoz chiqarib javob bering
board: 2) Past Simple bilan bitta voqeani aytib bering
scenes.say: Your turn. Pause the video and answer out loud: Have you ever travelled abroad? First give your experience with the Present Perfect, then tell me about one trip with the Past Simple. Speak for at least thirty seconds. No short answers.
scenes.say_uz: Navbat sizda. Videoni to'xtatib, ovoz chiqarib javob bering: Chet elga sayohat qilganmisiz? Avval tajribangizni Present Perfect bilan ayting, keyin bitta safarni Past Simple bilan hikoya qiling. Kamida 30 soniya gapiring. Qisqa javob yo'q.

scenes.title: Xulosa
scenes.say: Let's recap. A finished, specific time needs the Past Simple. Experience, a result now, or something continuing until now needs the Present Perfect. Do the test under this video, and I will see you in the next lesson.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Tugagan, aniq vaqt — Past Simple. Tajriba, hozirgi natija yoki hozirgacha davom etayotgan holat — Present Perfect. Video ostidagi testni bajaring, keyingi darsda ko'rishamiz.
